# S342 — wave start: an owner's landing-order answer does not order the wave

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer wave 2): the spec check asked wave.parser-lazy-overlap ("Which order do s455, s456 and s451 land in?") and the owner answered 1, s455 first, so s456 and s451 are cut from it. `ork wave start slicer s455 s450 s456 s451 s453 --yes` then started s455 and s456 at the same time and queued s451 for the next slot (ork-20261111-213809-3951, -6e14); they were stopped by hand. `ork wave suggest` had already put s456 in a later wave than s455 because they share snapshot.py. Wanted: wave start honours the suggested wave layering and any recorded order answer: an item starts only after the items it is ordered behind have landed.
